def backend.optsVal (v : go_etcd_io.bbolt.Options) (o : backend.OptsM) : Prop :=
  ∃ f, (BitVec.toNat f = 0 ∨ BitVec.toNat f = bbolt.mapPopulate) ∧ bbolt.optsVal v (o.toBolt false f)

def backend.boltLogger (l : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  match backend.theFs GF with
  | some c => bbolt.boltLogger l
  | none => iprop(True)

theorem backend.boltLogger_eq [bbolt_sem : go_etcd_io.bbolt.Assumptions] [S : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt]
    [ok : Fs.FsSemOk] [has : HasExt Fs.fsExt] [os.file.FieldAssumptions]
    [os.fileStat.FieldAssumptions] [backend.FsNoErrAll] (l : GoInterface) : backend.boltLogger l =
    bbolt.boltLogger l
